proposal.message: Hi — we noticed your Thesis subscription is coming up for renewal. As a thank-you for sticking with us, we'd like to offer you 15% off your next cycle. No action needed; it applies automatically at checkout.

human_notes: Clear, on-brand, action matches the reason perfectly.

proposal.message: Looks like you might have more Thesis than you need right now — that's actually pretty common. Want to push your next shipment back a few weeks? You stay subscribed, just on your schedule.

human_notes: Excellent tone. Directly names the problem without being accusatory.

proposal.message: We hear you — results can take time, and that's frustrating. A lot of our members notice the biggest shift around weeks 6–8. Here's what a few of them said after they stuck with it. Worth a read before making any changes.

human_notes: Good empathy, reasonable specificity. Could name the subscriber's formula.

proposal.message: Your last payment didn't go through — no worries, it happens. Update your payment details here and we'll take care of the rest. Your subscription stays active in the meantime.

human_notes: Clear, low-pressure, correct urgency. 'No worries, it happens' is good tone.

proposal.message: We noticed you've been on Motivation — which has some stimulant ingredients. If you're finding it a bit much, our Clarity formula is caffeine-free and might be a better fit. Happy to swap your next shipment at no charge.

human_notes: Specific to the subscriber's formula. Swap offer is practical and low-risk.

proposal.message: Life gets busy — we get it. If now's not the right time for Thesis, you can pause your subscription for up to 3 months and pick back up whenever you're ready. No penalties, no pressure.

human_notes: Good tone, correct action. Slightly generic — doesn't reference their tenure.

proposal.message: We know $79 is a real commitment. Here's how most of our members think about it: that's about $2.60 a day for a stack that's built around your specific goals — not a generic multivitamin. If price is the concern, let us know and we can talk options.

human_notes: The per-day framing is effective. Ends with an open door, not a hard sell.

proposal.message: We'd love to connect you with one of our advisors — they've helped a lot of members who weren't feeling the effects adjust their stack or timing. No charge, just a quick call. Interested?

human_notes: Reasonable but the message is vague. What would the advisor actually do?

proposal.message: You can pause anytime. We'll stop shipments until you're ready, and your subscription stays in place — so you don't have to re-do the quiz or restart. Just come back when your supply runs low.

human_notes: Mentions the quiz, which adds a nice touch of product familiarity.

proposal.message: SPECIAL OFFER: Cancel now and lose your discount forever! Our records show your account is at risk. Please act immediately to secure your subscriber rate before it expires.

human_notes: Panicked, threatening tone. Completely off-brand. High urgency for low-risk subscriber.

proposal.message: Many customers love our products. Here are some reviews. We hope you enjoy your subscription.

human_notes: Generic to the point of useless. No reference to subscriber or their concern.

proposal.message: If you've been experiencing side effects from your current formula, switching to a caffeine-free option may help. Our Clarity (Caffeine-Free) formula offers the same cognitive support without stimulants. We can process a swap with your next order.

human_notes: Correct and clear. Slightly clinical in tone but informative.

proposal.message: We weren't able to process your most recent payment. To keep your subscription active, please update your payment information at your earliest convenience.

human_notes: Accurate but cold. 'At your earliest convenience' feels corporate. Missing warmth.

proposal.message: Sometimes one formula is enough — especially if life's gotten busier or your goals have shifted. We can reduce your subscription to a single formula and lower your monthly cost. Easy change, no re-enrollment.

human_notes: Practical and empathetic. Addresses real subscriber flexibility.

proposal.message: We see you're well-stocked — that's a good problem to have. Stretch your subscription to every 6 weeks instead of every 4, and your supply catches up with your intake. Takes 10 seconds to adjust.

human_notes: Best in class. Specific numbers, practical solution, confident tone.
